identity.name: SilverLakes
identity.notes: SilverLakes is a gated community established in 1990 in Southwest Broward County (Pembroke Pines), Florida. It is governed by a master HOA covering 39 communities, managed by Pines Property Management, with security provided by FPI - SilverLakes Security. The community emphasizes preserving natural resources, wildlife, open space, wetlands, and tree-lined streets.

fees.note: Resident-reported range of $180–$295/month per hoa-agent.com (resident-submitted data; explicitly noted as not a guaranteed fee). No special assessment signals reported. Verify with the association directly. Official site has an Assessments page but no amounts were stated in the provided content.

Master HOA (SilverLakes Community Association) maintenance assessment is billed quarterly (due Jan 1, Apr 1, Jul 1, Oct 1), budgeted and subject to annual change. Exact dollar amount is NOT published on the official site and varies by parcel. 15-day grace period before late fee (per Pines Property Management). Paid via resident portal (engage.goenumerate.com / portal.pinespropertymanagement.com) or check to Pines Property Management, PO Box 522395, Miami FL 33152. Obtain current amount via estoppel letter from Pines Property Management, 6941 SW 196 Ave Ste 27, Pembroke Pines FL 33332, (954) 438-6570 (estoppel letter page: silverlakes.net/estoppel-letter.html). Confidence high on structure, amount unknown/unverified here (see hoa-agent resident-submitted range below). Related: pinespropertymanagement.zendesk.com article 217141758 confirms quarterly due dates and 15th-of-quarter late-fee cutoff; silverlakes.net/estoppel-letter.html gives the estoppel/management contact address and phone 954-438-6570; silverlakes.net/pines-property-management-contacts.html lists office hours and payment portal info (all read).

Resident-submitted observed HOA fee range of $180-$295/month (site labels it 'resident-verified' but also 'not a guaranteed fee; always verify with the association directly'). Low confidence - unverified resident submissions; treat as indicative only. No special assessment signals reported on the page.

Most residents ALSO pay a separate sub-association assessment (39 sub-associations) for exclusive amenities such as community pools, landscaping, entrance gates, manned gates, and overflow parking. Billed separately by each sub-association; amounts vary by community and are not published in aggregate.

Discounted bulk cable TV and internet (Blue Stream Fiber) is a resident amenity billed along with the SilverLakes quarterly assessments. Experience center: The Shoppes of SilverLakes, 18215 Pines Blvd, Pembroke Pines FL 33029, phone 844-644-3030 (per silverlakes.net/bluestream-fiber.html). Rate not stated.

SilverLakes Community Park pavilion (925 NW 178 Ave) can be reserved by current homeowners for $50 per event; contact Pines Property Management (954) 438-6570. Also confirmed on silverlakes.net/faqs.html.

Master association assessments billed quarterly and subject to annual change; exact amounts vary by property type and sub-association and are not published in aggregate. Sub-association fees are billed separately. Transfer fees, capital contributions, and special assessments unavailable from public sources.

SilverLakes Community Park, 925 NW 178 Avenue, Pembroke Pines FL 33029 - private park for SilverLakes residents only. Resort-style swimming pool, playground, sand beach, volleyball area, exercise equipment, barbeque station, boardwalk, large field, and an outdoor pavilion reservable for parties. Pool access is by bluetooth smart device via the Open Path app, dawn to dusk; limited to property owners, tenants (association-approved lease on file) and their guests; private parties not permitted on pool deck grounds.

Three private resident-only boater's parks: North (1001 NW 182 Way - boat ramp, large picnic area), West (SW 182 Ave - playground, 2 small picnic pavilions, exercise equipment), South (1401 SW 178 Ave - 3 small picnic pavilions, barbeque station, basketball court, volleyball area).

Silverlakes Clubhouse is managed by West Broward Hall, 927 NW 178th Ave, Pembroke Pines FL 33029, (954) 538-3755. The HOA board meets quarterly there (per thewilsonrealestategroup.com community guide, which describes West Broward Hall at SilverLakes Community Park).

SilverLakes Security is provided by FPI Security Patrol, 1771 N Flamingo Road, Pembroke Pines FL 33028. Emergency: dial 911; report security issues to FPI Security directly. (Patrol hours not stated on the page; see open questions.)

SilverLakes is gated at the sub-association level: sub-association-owned amenities include entrance gates and manned gates (varies by sub-community), maintained with separately billed sub-association assessments.

Residents permitted up to three (3) domesticated pets per household. Dogs must be on a leash; residents must pick up after pets; Pit Bulls are not permitted (AKC/UKC-conforming breeds). Pet waste stations installed around the community; 10% discount at Natural K9 with code EARTH10. (Per Declaration & Protective Covenants pp.199-200.)

SilverLakes negotiates a discounted bulk cable TV/internet rate (Blue Stream Fiber) for all residents, billed with the quarterly assessment. Experience center at The Shoppes of SilverLakes, 18215 Pines Blvd (per silverlakes.net/bluestream-fiber.html).

City-managed parks within/around the community: SilverLakes North Park (2300 NW 172nd Ave - tennis courts, basketball, volleyball, playground); SilverLakes South Park (17601 SW 2nd St - tennis courts, baseball field, playground, pool); SilverLakes Tennis Center (3302 SW 176th Terrace - tennis courts, basketball court, play area); SilverLakes Sports Complex (17540 SW 23rd St, Miramar - baseball/softball, concessions, walking trail).

Pembroke Lakes Golf & Racquet Club, 10500 Taft Street, Pembroke Pines FL 33026, (954) 431-4144 - 18-hole golf course, restaurant, 9 hard tennis courts, 5 clay tennis courts, pool. Listed on the official HOA parks page as a nearby recreation option.

Realtor community guide states SilverLakes 'contains a bicycle/walking path' and is home to three parks and a tennis center on community property, plus 13 dog waste stations along 178th Avenue. (Realtor-sourced; medium confidence.)

Established 1990 on a former limestone mine site; 5,186 homes and 319 commercial parcels on ~2,400 privately owned acres of parks, lakes, and wetlands; 750 acres of lakes and waterways, 276 acres of replanted wetlands, 30 miles of shoreline, 19 mini-parks and 3 large parks; Waterfowl Habitat Designation awarded by State of Florida Bureau of Mine Reclamation in 1999 (per silverlakes.net/parks--recreation.html, Commemorative Cove section).
Privately owned facility at the south end of SilverLakes Community Park, available for rental via Party Explosion (954) 538-3755.

open_questions: Exact current master-HOA assessment dollar amount is not published on silverlakes.net or the management company site (amounts vary by parcel and change annually). Must be confirmed via an estoppel letter from Pines Property Management, (954) 438-6570, 6941 SW 196 Ave Ste 27, Pembroke Pines FL 33332. The only numeric figure found is a resident-submitted $180-$295/month range on hoa-agent.com (unverified).
Sub-association assessment amounts (e.g., Brittany, Pelican Isle, Sapphire Shores) - billed separately, vary by community; not published in aggregate.

No CDD (Community Development District) or CDD special assessment for SilverLakes was found in any source checked; unclear whether one applies. hoabulletinboard.com notes transfer fees/capital contributions/special assessments are 'unavailable from public sources.'

FPI security patrol hours: the official FPI page gives only the address and 'contact FPI directly.' A 2020 board-minutes PDF (silverlakes.net/uploads/.../bod_minutes_9.21.20.pdf, snippet only) mentions the FPI contract renewal and reducing the 24-hour shift (7:30pm-7:30am) to 12 hours for 120 complimentary hours, and a Sapphire Shores sub-association PDF (sapphireshores.org/pdf/slhm.pdf, snippet only) states '24-hour roving security through the local police departments' with detail lines (954) 205-1873 (Pembroke Pines) / (954) 205-1872 (Miramar). Both PDFs could not be parsed as text, so these details are unverified.
Driving distances in miles from the community to shopping/library/hospital/schools were not stated on any page read; distance_miles left null rather than estimated.
Address discrepancy for The Shoppes of SilverLakes: 18215 Pines Blvd (official BlueStream Fiber page) vs 18341 Pines Blvd (official Neighborhood Info page).
Home count discrepancy: official About page says 5,186 homes; realtor guide (thewilsonrealestategroup.com) says 5,500 homes and 23,000+ residents.
Pool hours: official page says the pool access system operates 'from dawn to dusk'; formal posted pool hours/cabana hours not found.
Rental restrictions exist at master level and may be stricter per sub-association (rental-restriction page exists on silverlakes.net); specifics not read in full.
